title: Social story / Multi-content navigation
slide_intent: Make a vertical sequence feel connected so a viewer can follow multiple recommendations within one story.
strategic_value: Moving tiles and gradient panels can give Channel 4 a recognizable social-story rhythm.
demonstration: The clip moves from footage through a Stream now panel and a tiled sequence of programme portraits to First Dates. The published poster shows a hand-held phone outdoors; the video uses a phone on a plain surface.
practical_value: Compare how the same tiled system moves between footage, action and programme title.

content_islands.name: Published context
content_islands.spec: Preserve the outdoor hand-held phone as the source preview.

content_islands.name: Playable story
content_islands.spec: Show moving portrait tiles and gradient rooms within the vertical social frame.

reference_purposes.Application: The animation applies the multi-content world system to a social story.
